newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius bourse falls on sentiment subdued.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius bourse falls on sentiment subdued.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Mauritius share index, Semdex, fell 0.77 points to 378.45 on Monday, reflecting declines in a wide range of stocks and a subdued mood, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 4.39 million rupees on 138,972 shares, from 9.86 million rupees on 351,310 shares last Friday.
Brokers said investors were adopting a wait-and-see attitude before the budget speech next Monday.
"Foreign investors are staying on the side line," one broker said.
The Mauritius Commercial Bank (MCB) lost 1.00 rupee to 87.50 rupees on 7,191 shares and State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) climbed 20 cents to 11.70 rupees on 15,800 shares.

Hotel-based Sun Resorts fell 30 cents to 48.50 rupees on 10,200 shares, New Mauritius Hotels (NMH) edged 10 cents to 36.40 rupees on 2,000 shares and Grand Baie Hotel (GBH) was stable at 47.20 rupees on 500 shares.
In the transport sector, the only company listed national carrier Air Mauritius eased 90 cents to 39.00 rupees on 2,380 shares.
Conglomerates Rogers remained 98.50 rupees on 3,300 shares and Ireland Blyth Ltd (IBL) was unchanged to 15.50 rupees on 440 shares.

Investment companies Belle Mare Holding (BMH) lost 80 cents to 48.00 rupees on 25,301 shares, Fincorp fell 50 cents to 69.50 rupees on 350 shares and National Investment Trust (NIT) was stable at 10.90 rupees on 10,000 shares.
Sugar based Mount lost 40 cents to 21.50 rupees on 3,000 shares and Mon Tresor Mon Desert (MTMD) was 40 cents lower to 39.20 rupees on 350 shares.
